observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel gas cooker with four burners and four control knobs on the front panel.
The cooktop has black metal grates over the burners.
The surface appears to be in used condition with some scratches and wear.
Photo 1 and Photo 2 show the same cooktop wrapped in clear plastic, with handwritten 'OIS' on the plastic.
The plastic wrap is crumpled and shows signs of handling.
No brand or model name is visible on the cooktop or any part of the unit in any photo.
The seller's text mentions 'Tokunbo' (imported second-hand) and 'fixed in your cabinet', but no visual evidence of installation or cabinet is shown.

claims.evidence: The cooktop shows visible scratches and wear (photo 0, 1, 2), contradicting 'neatly used'. The 'Tokunbo' claim is plausible but not visually verifiable from the photos.
No photo shows the cooker installed or in a cabinet. The seller's text is unverified by visual evidence.

risks.risk: The cooktop may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the burners lighting and operating, or a close-up of the control knobs and connections.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may hide deeper scratches, dents, or damage to the cooktop surface.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cooktop surface without plastic wrap, showing all sides and edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having significant surface damage

risks.risk: The unit may be missing parts (e.g., gas hoses, regulators, or installation kit) despite being wrapped.
risks.proof: A photo showing all components laid out, including any included accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the door or on the inside of the door frame.
A video showing the burners lighting and operating.
A close-up photo of the cooktop surface without plastic wrap.
A photo showing all included components and accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
